property_summary: For every admissible input, each successful external call made by transfer must carry calldata whose first selector argument decodes to `from` and whose second argument decodes to the corresponding `_tos[i]`; the bug instead always encodes `from` as the recipient, so the recorded recipient sequence differs for some input with a recipient unequal to `from`.
change_summary: Change the external call recipient from _tos[i] to from, so all transfers target the same address instead of each recipient.
